name: Snail
summary: A spiral shell, drawn entirely in points of light.
text:
The snail is almost all shell — one large spiral filled with points of light that trace the curve. The antennae come out in thin wood, and the body rests on the floor.

A calm piece, for anyone who wants light without a face looking back.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
